question: Urdu was declared the second official language of which one of the following state in 2017?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2017, **Telangana declared Urdu** as the second official language of the state.
 
• **Bihar** declared Urdu as its second official language in 1981
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** declared Urdu as its second official language in 1989.
 
• Urdu was given the status of an official language in 1950 when the Indian Constitution came into force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urdu** was included as one of the 15 languages initially listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• **Article 343** of the Indian Constitution: Declares Hindi in the Devanagari script as the official language of the Union.
 
• The **Eighth Schedule** of the Constitution lists the recognized languages that are entitled to develop and be promoted by the government.
 
• **Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali** were the latest additions, included in 2003 by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment.
 
• India protects minority languages under **Article 29** of the Constitution, which provides for the protection of cultural and linguistic rights.
